description:
A step towards building the next generation of leaders! 🌟

A highly engaging Rotaract Orientation at Laxmichand Golwala College, with about 600 plus students in 3 different classrooms , along with the Rotaract HRD Team, just a few days ahead of our Installation Ceremony.

The session witnessed enthusiastic participation, inspiring interactions and a wonderful response from students eager to enrol and become Rotaractors.

Excited to welcome a new generation of young leaders who believe in friendship, fellowship and service! ❤️

Here’s to growing Rotaract, creating impact and inspiring change!

Rtn Poojaa Mehhtaa - RC Mumbai Kalakar- Youth Director

Rtn Suparna Chakravarty- RC Mumbai Kalakar- President
location: Laxmichand Golwala college, Ghatkopar East, Mumbai., Maharashtra
